headline: Kioxia's weak guidance hits memory after Friday's 7% chip selloff
tldr: US markets are closed today (Sunday) and reopen Monday at 9:30 ET (8:30 SK). Futures are up 0.2–0.4% Sunday night, but Kioxia's weak outlook and Taiwan's soft start point to a mixed-to-weak Monday for MU after Friday's 5.3% drop.
